# [TASK] TMDB-shaped person endpoints with read-through/save-through (actor-service)

## Task
Extend actor-service (#18) with TMDB v3-shaped person endpoints, read-through/save-through against PostgreSQL, so the React app's actor pages can call them directly.

## Parent Story
Parent: #91

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `GET /person/{id}`, `/person/{id}/movie_credits`, `/person/{id}/images`, `/person/popular`, `/search/person` implemented — [`PersonFacadeController`](../blob/main/backend/actor-service/src/main/java/com/filmpire/actor/facade/PersonFacadeController.java); `discover/movie?with_cast=` delegated to movie-service per ADR-002 (movie-list data belongs there, not actor-service)
- [x] Read-through/save-through against the persisted `actors` table; rate-limited TMDB client (`TmdbRateLimitInterceptor`, Bucket4j, 40 req/10s)
- [x] Field-diff against real TMDB confirms the React app's actor page renders fully from this backend (12 of 13 comparable fields identical; `deathday` intentionally not modeled, unused by the app)
- [x] Repeat requests are served from PostgreSQL only — confirmed live (145ms cold vs 6.6ms warm) and WireMock-asserted in tests
- [x] `ActorServiceIntegrationTest` green: full controller -> service -> Testcontainers-PostgreSQL -> WireMock-TMDB stack

## Estimate
**Hours:** 9

## Notes
Original spec required lossless round-trip of TMDB JSON — superseded by ADR-010 (typed, mapped catalog instead of raw passthrough). Only consequence: `deathday` isn't stored; no consumer reads it.
